'''Mayr Stillman''' was the [[Medical Supervisor]] of [[Garrison Base Bakura]]. Following the [[Battle of Bakura]], Stillman joined [[Denno Yanglan]] and [[Rafe Shahverdian]] in leaving [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] aboard the ''[[Wayfaring Stranger]]''. While Yanglan and Shahverdian intended to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], Stillman was still loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and hoped to infiltrate the Alliance
